name: Christian Bazzucchi
title: Geologist & Spatial Data Engineer | GIS Architect
summary: Geologist and computer scientist with over 18 years of specialized experience in GIS, spatial databases, and data architectures. Extensive expertise in integrating geospatial data, pipeline automation (Python, Spatial SQL), environmental characterization, and coordinating technical teams across utility, telecommunication, and agricultural sectors.

Domains & Methodologies: Contaminated Sites Remediation & Health Risk Analysis

experiences.role: GIS Expert & Service Manager (Fiber Optic Networks)
experiences.description: Geospatial architecture and technical coordination for large-scale fiber optic network design (GISFO), topological validation pipelines, and service management for top-tier infrastructure clients.
highlights: Automated topological integrity validation and bill-of-quantities calculation pipelines using Python and PostGIS.
Management of enterprise geospatial databases and technical workflows.

experiences.description: Consulting on WebGIS development, mobile cartography, and utility network management.
highlights: Ingegnerie Toscane (2015–2018): GIS management of regional water and wastewater networks via Smallworld and ArcGIS.
Copernico: Built 'Brunello App' (Consorzio del Vino Brunello di Montalcino) mobile mapping and Agrinex precision viticulture WebGIS (featured on 'L'Enologo').

experiences.role: Technical Consultant – Oil & Gas Geospatial Software
experiences.description: Technical-scientific system cloning and integration for geophysical exploration, reservoir engineering, and subsurface databases during the Stogit spinoff from ENI to Snam.
highlights: Subsurface database integration across Petrel, Techlog, OpenWorks, and ArcSDE.
Real-time geospatial alerting and mapping systems.

experiences.description: BPMN2 workflow implementation with Activiti/Spring for safety report management, and open-source cartographic portal development (OpenLayers, GeoServer, PostgreSQL).
highlights: Site geology oversight for turbogas plant construction and industrial landfill development.
Enterprise document workflow and WebGIS architecture.

experiences.description: End-to-end management of custom enterprise WebGIS solutions using Java, Oracle, and Autodesk Topobase frameworks.
highlights: Specification, development, testing, and production deployment of multi-user geographic workflows.

experiences.description: Geospatial database design, environmental characterization under D.Lgs 152/2006, health risk assessment (RBCA, Rome, Giuditta), and WebGIS development presented at Consoil 2008.
highlights: Designed centralized database for real-time site monitoring and automatic reporting.
Consoil 2008 paper on Java/ArcIMS environmental WebGIS for petrochemical sites.
Differential GPS surveys on contaminated industrial sites.

education.institution: University of Florence (Università degli Studi di Firenze)
education.details: Specialization in applied geology, hydrogeology, and remote sensing.
Geological and environmental risk, mining decommissioning, SAR interferometry, and open-source geospatial programming.
